notes: G5 of the study pre-registered in validation/protocols/flow-pulse-external-references-v1.md.
Exact matches: 62693 of 72078 catchment cells (87.0%), reported with no threshold as the protocol requires.

maxAbsDiff is the largest relative difference, 17457, on a cell where Flow Pulse routes a large upstream area through a cell to which GRASS gives a small one. A relative difference is unbounded when the reference value is small.

GRASS reference properties that bound agreement below 100%: the module routes by least cost rather than by steepest descent on a filled surface, the published "filled" DEM still holds closed depressions, and the published accumulation disagrees with the published directions on about 0.14% of cells.

reference.containerPinningNote: The reference was not executed here. Its authors ran it and published the output on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.18790150); the version comes from the GeoTIFF software tag and no command or container is published. The bytes compared are pinned by sha256 in the dataset register instead.
reference.executablePath: zenodo.18790150/flow_dir_GRASS.tif and flow_acc_GRASS.tif (published output; no executable path is published)
reference.commandLine: not published; the direction encoding and the signed integer accumulation are those of r.watershed in single-flow mode

datasets.description: GRASS GIS 8.3.2 direction and accumulation over Reunion at 25 m, with the Riviere des Pluies catchment polygon. Acquired, not vendored.
A 589 x 294 window over the catchment: 169,684 valid cells, 72,078 catchment cells.

parameterSets.description: D8 routing over the Priority-Flood surface with a Float64 step gradient and NoData read as an outlet, at 25 m square cells. The catchment is delineated from the mouth cell, row 2 and column 191 of the fixture.

candidateParameters.rowOrder: fixture rows reversed so row 0 is south

referenceParameters.catchment: catchment_1.shp rasterised with gdal_rasterize, cell-centre rule
referenceParameters.accumulation: absolute value of the published accumulation

metrics.toleranceUnit: relative to the absolute GRASS accumulation

statusReason: 68627 of 72078 catchment cells (95.2%) are within 5% of the GRASS accumulation, against a 90% gate. Nothing was widened.

unsupported: Exact accumulation. About 13% of catchment cells differ from the reference, most of them by less than 5%.
Contributing area in square metres beyond cell count times the 25 m cell.
D8 tie order and flat resolution.
Flow length and the Rational-method peak-flow estimate (TERRAIN-FLOW-RATIONAL-PEAK).
Accuracy against the ground. Agreement with another program is not field validation, and archival data cannot reach E5.
